title: world_directory/1 — GET /worlds: the worlds a caller may choose between (SPEC-028). A DIRECTORY, never canon: an id, a name, a look, and whether anyone can play it. No world state on this surface.

display_name.description: The world's name as a chooser sees it. The one label in the system that is not viewer-relative, because it names the CONTAINER rather than anything inside it — B-1 governs what is in a world.

playable.description: Whether this world states a player (world.player_entity_id). False for a world created through POST /worlds that has nothing authored into it yet — real, listed, and not yet enterable.

world_theme.description: SPEC-019 theme tokens. ONE accent colour — the frontend derives the rest, because a backend shipping a palette would own visual design it has no business owning. mood is an ATMOSPHERE word, never a genre: the system never learns the word 'fantasy' (GA-3).

mood.description: Draft vocabulary: daylight | nocturne | mist | ember | bleak. Deliberately NOT constrained to that set — unknown values must DEGRADE in the client, never fail here. Enforcing the enum backend-side would make this service the thing that breaks on a word it has not heard of, which is backwards for a field whose purpose is to evolve.

ornament.description: Draft vocabulary: none | filigree | rivet | vine | circuit. Unconstrained for the same reason as mood.
